title: The open month's coverage scale counts 744 h for the 743-hour March: a fully settled DST month reads 0.13 % high
claim: ledger.coverage_factor divides ledger.month_hours (days x 24, 744 for March 2026) by the settled hours, so a March settled for every one of its 743 real hours scales every estimated row figure by 1.001346 instead of 1.0.
mechanism: ledger.py month_hours ignores the DST hour (its docstring says so); coverage_factor = max(1, month_hours/settled). October (745 h) clamps to 1.0, so only the spring month is off; it lasts until the month closes.

evidence.contention_note: fan-out: up to three seats share the box; a count, contention-immune

perturbation.change: --perturb realhours: ledger.month_hours counts the month's real hours in the zone

metric_definition: coverage_full = ledger.coverage_factor of a month whose settled-hours meta equals its real UTC hours, read on the month's last minute (identity 1.0)
phenomenon_property: An open month settled over all of its real hours is estimated at scale 1.0, its real hours counted in the zone the month is booked in.
proposed_fix_scope: ledger.month_hours: the real hours between the month's local midnights
